title: Front Cup Holder Size and Layout
summary: Feedback centers on front cup holder size, placement, closure design, and compatibility with different drink containers, but many fragments are too terse or coded to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the larger cup holder and improved fit for different containers after repositioning away from dashboard controls.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback combines appreciation for the cup holder area with complaints about poor cup retention, limited quantity, awkward location, bouncing containers, and difficult retractable closure.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention cup holder plastics, nearby USB cord exposure, the missing retractable lid, shifter clearance, and other cup holder references without enough context for reliable sentiment classification.

limitations: Many sample fragments are short coded prompts such as 'Which Cup Holders DTU' or 'Why Cup Holders DTU' and do not provide enough context to interpret the underlying issue.
Some evidence within the topic mixes cup holder design with nearby console elements such as the shifter, USB location, and lid cover, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
Several examples that sound favorable or unfavorable are labeled undetermined, so sentiment interpretation is constrained by the supplied assignments.
